text:
frank-cust: Hey team, after the 14:00 deploy our console trace view stopped linking X-Request-ID to traces. We see request IDs in the API logs but the trace panel shows 'no spans found' when you search by ID.

maya-support: Sorry about that — can you share a specific request-id and approximate timestamp? Also which org/project is this under?

frank-cust: request id 8a3f7c9d-02ea-4b, hit at 2026-03-15T14:12:05Z. Org: acme-archives, project: ingest-api-prod. I attached a screenshot of the console showing empty trace.

maya-support: got it. tagging eng to investigate. @derek-eng can you look at trace indexing around that time?

oncall-bot: Incident created #INC-2026-145: Trace linking regression detected in console (priority: P2).

derek-eng: looking. quick question — do you send request-id in both X-Request-ID and as trace_id in the payload? any sampling header?

frank-cust: we only set X-Request-ID and propagate it as x-req-id to downstream services. No sampling header set by client.

derek-eng: ok thanks. can you run a curl with that header and paste the request/response headers? e.g.
```
curl -i -H "X-Request-ID: 8a3f7c9d-02ea-4b" -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/ingest
```

frank-cust: ran it, got 202 Accepted and header X-Trace-ID: none. Response headers: `Connection: keep-alive, Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2026 14:12:06 GMT, X-Request-ID: 8a3f7c9d-02ea-4b`. No trace id returned.

maya-support: that suggests the trace sampler or the trace-forwarding path didn't attach the platform trace id. @derek-eng any logs showing failed span exports or dropped spans?

derek-eng: digging through exporter logs now. I see a spike of 'parent missing' logs around 14:00:
```
ERROR exporter/span_forwarder.go:142 failed to associate span: parent not found for span_id=0x9f3a reason=missing-parent
```
Also a separate error at 14:12:04:
```
WARN traceindexer/indexer.go:88 write skipped for request_id=8a3f7c9d-02ea-4b reason=missing-traceid
```

frank-cust: any idea what would cause missing-traceid? We didn't change headers on our side.

derek-eng: preliminary hypothesis: a recent optimization to drop empty parent refs when sampling was off introduced a regression where the platform-level trace id isn't created if no sampled spans originate at the edge. That prevents the request id -> trace mapping from being written.

sanjay-pm: timeline — this optimization landed in release v2026.3.14 at 13:58 UTC. That matches.

maya-support: next steps: derek, can you add a short-term fix to write trace mapping even when sampled==false? And frank, can you confirm if you need historical link-back to traces or only new traffic?

frank-cust: ideally we need links for ~the last hour (we lost ~40 events), but if you can restore new traffic mapping that's fine for now. We have an SRE runbook relying on traces for debugging.

derek-eng: I'll patch indexer to fall back to a minimal trace id creation if request has X-Request-ID and no trace id present. I'll push a hotfix to canary and post the deploy id here.

oncall-bot: Deploy started: deploy-2026-1170 to canary (derek-eng).

derek-eng: canary up, tested with your request id and I can now see X-Trace-ID returned and the trace appears in console. Deploying to prod rollup in 10m.

maya-support: thanks both. frank-cust, once prod rollup is done please verify the older missing entries — we may need a backfill job to re-index the past hour.

frank-cust: confirmed trace now appears for new requests. Please open a backfill ticket for the hour starting 13:55-14:55 UTC.

maya-support: created ticket TKT-5467 for backfill and CC'd you. closing this thread when backfill complete. :thumbsup:

frank-cust: thanks, appreciated the fast turnaround.
